Running command: cd /workspace && cat > candidate_trace.json <<'EOF'
[
  {"step":1,"file":"src/md4c.c","function":"md_process_line","line":6528,"var":"line->beg..line->end","code":"if((ctx->parser.flags & MD_FLAG_ADMONITIONS) && ctx->n_containers > 0 && ctx->containers[ctx->n_containers-1].ch == '>' && ctx->current_block == NULL && ctx->n_block_bytes >= sizeof(MD_BLOCK))","note":"A quote-block line is examined for the admonition fast path after the parser has already classified the current line."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/md4c.c","function":"md_process_line","line":6530,"var":"block","code":"MD_BLOCK* block = (MD_BLOCK*)((char*)ctx->block_bytes + ctx->n_block_bytes - sizeof(MD_BLOCK));","note":"The code reaches back to the previously emitted block, which is expected to be the quote block that started the container."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/md4c.c","function":"md_process_line","line":6532,"var":"line->beg","code":"if(block->type == MD_BLOCK_QUOTE && line->end - line->beg > 3 && line->end - line->beg < 16 && CH(line->beg) == '[' && CH(line->beg+1) == '!' && CH(line->end-1) == ']')","note":"An admonition marker like [!NOTE] is recognized inside the quote block and the block is retagged as an admonition."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/md4c.c","function":"md_process_line","line":6541,"var":"ctx->containers[ctx->n_containers-1].is_admonition","code":"ctx->containers[ctx->n_containers-1].is_admonition = TRUE; block->type = MD_BLOCK_ADMONITION; block->data = i;","note":"The quote container is marked as an admonition, but the surrounding line-analysis state is not reset here."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/md4c.c","function":"md_process_line","line":6296,"var":"pivot_line->type","code":"if(pivot_line->type == MD_LINE_TABLE && n_parents == ctx->n_containers) { line->type = MD_LINE_TABLE; break; }","note":"Because the previous line was a table row, the table-continuation state remains active for the next line."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/md4c.c","function":"md_process_line","line":6489,"var":"line->type","code":"MD_CHECK(md_start_new_block(ctx, line));","note":"The parser starts a new block for the next line while the stale table state is still in effect."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/md4c.c","function":"md_start_new_block","line":5190,"var":"line->type","code":"switch(line->type)","note":"The new-block dispatcher assumes only the supported line types can arrive here."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/md4c.c","function":"md_start_new_block","line":5225,"var":"line->type","code":"case MD_LINE_TABLEUNDERLINE: default: MD_UNREACHABLE();","note":"An unsupported line type reaches the default arm, causing an out-of-bounds access through the generated switch table and triggering the memory-safety bug."}
]
EOF
bash submit.sh /tmp/poc.md /workspace/candidate_trace.json
